_comment: Records what the planning document asked for versus what the Web IQ v3 GA surface actually supports. Deviations here are reportable findings, not implementation shortcuts.

known_constraints.passage_mode: contentFormat=passage returns query-relevant excerpts rather than full page text

C1.name: POI 기본 속성 - 영업시간·휴무
C1.impact: No dedicated places vertical exists, so structured opening-hours fields are unavailable. Hours must be extracted from free-text passages, which raises the extraction-error floor for the highest-priority category.

C2.name: 트렌드·소셜 기반 장소
C2.impact: This is one of the two categories the customer explicitly complained about, and it is served by the generic web vertical with no trend or popularity signal.

C3.name: 금융·시세
C3.impact: The second customer-flagged category. No finance vertical means no real-time quote feed; same-day or real-time freshness cannot be guaranteed from web passages alone. A ground-truth market-price source is still required to score this category.

C4.name: 실시간 교통·이슈
C4.impact: Traffic incidents are often not indexed as news. Web is primary, news is a secondary probe.

44.reason: The question asks about recalls within the last month, but the news vertical only covers roughly 14 days.

C7.name: 함정 문항 - 환각 검증
C7.note: Traps must be routed identically to real questions. Any special-casing would invalidate the hallucination axis.
